points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 97bdc69 clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB with /opt/external; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:138–200 validates configured case/mesh path, root-only reads and distributes; CLI supports restart and explicit time/step overrides. Root-only restart error path may leave peers waiting.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case_input, global/distributed mesh, partition, physics and solver modules; large solver.cpp combines several iterative algorithms.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal existing-solver wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and case_input.cpp read configurable case/mesh; no hard-coded two-filename-only branch identified. Production perturbation center is disclosed in solver.cpp:212–221.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:183–200 root-only global mesh preprocessing; distributed_mesh and neighbor exchanges supply owned/ghost cells. Report shows Re20 np1/8 final Cd 2.040/1.846 (9.5% of np1), not order-one.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp checks missing mesh on all ranks; positivity fallback and iteration caps exist. Nonlinear freeze and transient target statistics limit convergence assurances; restart root-only errors may deadlock peers.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable src contains test_mesh.cpp, test_jacobian.cpp and several test_lusgs variants; no evaluator CFD rerun or full verified regression suite. Contestant report contains np1/8 comparisons.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source excludes raw outputs; tools/plot_histories.py:59–65 generates mislabeled x=0 steady force charts. Debug/experimental solver options present.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.cpp:488 onward assembles interior and boundary compressible flow residuals, including viscous term. Frozen steady reconstruction and limited case validation qualify claimed accuracy.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp reads configured CGNS, partition.cpp:70 METIS, distributed_mesh.cpp local mesh/ghost construction; root retains full mesh but nonroot does not during iterations.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: physics.cpp:488 onward assembles flux balance; solver.cpp:1591–1657 freezes nonlinear gradients within inner target checks and for final steady stages, then may recompute accepted gradients.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp:193–262 implements approximate inviscid flux choices; solver.cpp:161–162 selects Roe/Rusanov and report discloses case choices. No independent flux-order study.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: physics.cpp: boundary_face_flux handles farfield, slip and no-slip; solver.cpp:1887 onward writes wall velocity and Cp/Cf. Wake contours exist but do not guarantee accuracy.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ and limiter source exist, but solver.cpp:1558–1594 freezes gradients/limiters after documented step 500/800 in final steady runs. Frozen-residual convergence is not independently full nonlinear second-order convergence.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: physics.cpp:70–132 computes Venkatakrishnan limits; solver.cpp:1558–1594 freezes these with gradients at disclosed step 500/800. Optional first-order/limiter bypass exists; production bypass not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: physics.cpp:531–556 integrates full viscous traction as viscous force, while report.tex:171 calls it tangential wall shear; surface Cf is separately projected. Normal contribution is unquantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:1081 onward implements LU-SGS iterations, with optional matrix-free GMRES at :694; convergence quality limited by frozen residual criterion.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 residual exists, but first step uses two freestream histories instead of explicit BDF1; solver.cpp:1591–1657 counts target on frozen reconstruction before recomputing accepted-state gradients, so strict updated-residual misses are unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Source and delivered-result evidence; no evaluator rerun.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight canonical packages passed prior structural validation; seven steady force plots do not expose history, and transient strict updated-residual target is unverified.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator accepted eight packages and report; structural pass does not verify physical convergence or target residual with updated reconstruction.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All canonical packages validate structurally; seven steady statuses use documented frozen reconstruction, Re200 finishes t300 but strict updated-residual target count is not established.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Raw force tails and Re200 repeated crossings support plausible attempts; frozen reconstruction, transient target accounting and Re20 np1/8 difference limit accuracy confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All seven steady force plots collapse at physical_time=0, not pseudo-step histories; Re200 startup drag compresses late drag. Case-specific fields/residual plots are present.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses frozen reconstruction and rank spread, but claims tangential integrated shear while code integrates full traction; steady force graphs do not show time evolution.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest maps canonical cases and figures; original metadata git_revision=null and inner target measures frozen residual, not proven accepted-state fully updated residual.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme

sections.title: Viscous Terms

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained. Manifest selects final_cylinder_m010_laminar_re200_np3, 30000 steps to t=300. Original t≥200 Cd mean 1.3598541, range 1.17613–1.55164; Cl -1.29846–1.18364. Positive lift crossings yield usual periods 4.48–4.63 (one short spurious crossing pair excluded), supporting reported St≈0.218. Accepted PDF p7 includes residual and wake contours, but startup Cd≈35 makes late drag oscillation unreadable and no alternative delivered late Cd plot was found. Source evaluates inner ratio with frozen reconstruction and recomputes accepted-state gradients after acceptance; reported 1.0 fraction refers to frozen residual and exact fully updated strict misses are unknown. First physical step uses BDF2 with both previous levels freestream, not a separately coded BDF1 bootstrap. No CFD rerun.

flags.notes: No source-evident internal solver executable wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.
Original workspace histories and fields document real case attempts; collapsed plot axes are a plotting defect, not proof data were fabricated.
case_input.cpp and global_mesh.cpp read configured case/mesh path; no two-filename-only dispatch found.
Report gives Re20 np1/8 Cd 2.040/1.846, 9.5% relative difference, not order-one. No general rank-invariance guarantee.
solver.cpp:1081 onward implements implicit LU-SGS; :694 optional GMRES and BDF2 temporal residual exist.

Roe/Rusanov, LSQ, limiter, viscous and BDF2 code exist. Full-traction force split differs from claimed tangential output but does not establish an absent algorithm; compare established force-split precedent.

Re200 has repeated lift oscillations and full t300 run. Inner target fraction is measured on frozen-stencil residual; fully updated strict miss count cannot be inferred. Steady force tails and disclosed reconstruction freeze documented; no separate proven false-status finding.
Seven steady force plots misuse physical_time as x and collapse at zero; script reads the matching case CSV, so this plotting error alone does not prove figures derive from unrelated output.
partition.cpp:70 uses METIS; main.cpp:183–200 keeps full mesh on root only and distributes local mesh/halos. No all-rank full mesh or state during iterations found.

solver.cpp:1558–1594 freezes reconstruction after step 500/800 in final steady cases, explicitly disclosed in report.tex:207–212; optional first-order switch exists but production activation not established.
solver.cpp:1887 onward uses wall boundary data and outputs no-slip zero velocity; no adjacent-cell-as-wall misrepresentation established.
Manifest maps field figures to case VTUs and displayed variables; no affirmative swapped Mach/pressure finding. Not an exhaustive pixel audit.
No internal wrapper found; external similarity search excluded under trust policy.

limitations: Raw result data is intentionally excluded from the curated Git tip but retained on disk and assessed read-only.
No evaluator rerun was performed; Re200 was not rerun.
Report PDF/log is excluded from curated tip; report TeX and committed figures were inspected, and report claims were cross-checked against raw evidence.
Prohibited blobs remain reachable in preserved contestant ancestors despite index-only cleanup.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
